verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a pip-installable open-source library whose agents run in your own Python process. AutoGen Studio documents exporting teams to Python code and running them in a Docker container, so self-hosted execution is clearly supported. The evidence never states the stack is fully independent of a vendor platform: the quick-start pairs it with the OpenAI model extension, and nothing shows self-hosted or local model backends or production self-hosting guidance. missing for 10: evidence of local/self-hosted LLM backend support, an explicit statement of no hosted-platform dependency, production self-hosting/deployment docs, independent hands-on corroboration of a fully on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run my agents entirely on my own infrastructure with no dependence on the vendor's platform
